valor: Former swimmer Lidia Yuknavitch bears the scars of a childhood marred by abuse and a youth marked by addiction and failed relationships. Through swimming or writing, she confronts her traumas on a harrowing journey. A fragmented, sensory, poetic adaptation of her autobiographical book.
